visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white illustration depicting a dramatic scene where a man in a suit is recoiling or falling backward with his arms raised in distress. Behind him, a group of men in a small boat or vessel are observing or interacting with him, with one man pointing toward him. The background is dark and indistinct, suggesting a night or stormy setting.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: A small boat or rowboat, a man in a suit, a group of men in the boat, ropes or rigging, dark background.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: A man in the foreground appearing to be in distress or shock, and at least two or three men in a boat behind him.
visualDescription.uncertaintyNotes: The exact nature of the interaction between the man in the foreground and the men in the boat is ambiguous; it is unclear if he is being rescued, threatened, or reacting to something they have done. The setting is not clearly defined beyond the presence of a boat.
